groups.description: Per side and active slot: the Pokemon in play there, its volatiles and the slot's conditions.
Per side and roster entry (Team Preview order): the Pokemon's engine state.
Per seat, side and active slot: what that seat was shown or derives (not in toJSON).
Per seat: its own request and what it derives of the field.
Per seat, side and roster entry: the reveal masks and the history the seat derives from its own channel.
Per seat and side: what the seat derives of the side's conditions.
Per side: side conditions and faint counters.

fields.description: Move actions since the switch-in (the world facts' move_actions).
Turns since the switch-in (the world facts' active_turns).
Whether it was dragged in this turn.
Its last move (Encore, Disable).
The location its last move aimed at.
Its last move used, called moves included.
Whether a move may be disabled by a hidden cause (the own request).
Whether it may be locked into a move (the own request).
Whether it may be trapped by a hidden cause (the own request).
The move it used this turn.
Whether it switched in this turn.
The roster index of the Pokemon in each active slot, -1 empty.
Turns until a slot condition resolves (fixed by the condition, shown when it starts).
Whether each slot condition (Wish, a delayed move) is pending at the slot.
Whether it must switch out (the own forced-switch request).
Whether it is trapped (the own request).
A volatile's counter (the stall counter). Never projected (the seat's derived stall counter is its view).
Turns left of a timed volatile; some are engine draws. Never projected (the seat's started turn is its view).
A volatile's hit points (a Substitute). Never projected.
The layers of a stacking volatile (Stockpile).
Whether each volatile is up (locks, choice lock, stall and every other engine condition).
Whether the battle has ended.
The last move used by anyone (Copycat's reference; the history facts' field_last_move).
The engine's random-number state as opaque 32-bit words. Never projected.
The engine's Quick Claw roll of the turn. Never projected.
Whether the battle has started (after Team Preview).
The turn counter.
Turns left of a field condition. Never projected.
Whether each field condition (Trick Room, Gravity) is up.
The terrain.
Turns left of the terrain. Never projected.
The weather.
Turns left of the weather; it depends on the source's item. Never projected.
The current ability (after a Mega Evolution, the forme's).
A type added by a move (Forest's Curse, Trick-or-Treat).
Whether the Pokemon ate a berry.
Whether the Pokemon in each side and active slot hit it this turn.
The set's ability (before an Evolution or a change).
The set's move in each slot while Transform replaces the slots.
The species shown at Team Preview (the set's species).
The stat stages (the shown boost lines).
Whether it can still Mega Evolve (the own request's canMegaEvo).
Whether it has fainted.
Gender: 0 none, 1 M, 2 F, 3 N.
Current hit points; another seat sees the display rule's percentage.
Whether it was hurt this turn.
The Pokemon its Illusion shows: 0 none, else 1 + that roster index.
Whether it is in play.
The held item (a Mega Stone holder's stone is its item).
Whether the item was knocked off.
The item last used up (shown by the line that uses it).
The level shown in the details (the rule table's adjusted level).
Maximum hit points (level 50 and Stat Points enter here).
Whether the current forme is a Mega Evolution (the engine data's isMega of the forme).
The move in each slot.
Whether each slot is disabled (the own request shows it).
Last turn's move result: 0 none, 1 failed, 2 succeeded.
Maximum PP of each slot.
PP left in each slot.
This turn's move result: 0 none, 1 failed, 2 succeeded.
Whether each slot was used since the switch-in.
The Pokemon's index in the side's current order (the bench order).
How often it switched in.
Whether the details say shiny.
The current species forme (a Mega forme after the Evolution); a disguise hides it until it is shown.
The five stored stats other than HP (nature, level and Stat Points enter here).
Whether a stat fell this turn.
Whether a stat rose this turn.
The major status (the engine marks a fainted Pokemon fnt, which is roster.fainted and reads as none here).
The sleep counter, an engine draw. Never projected.
The bad-poison stage (the world facts count its ticks).
The sleep length the engine drew. Never projected.
Hits taken (Rage Fist).
Whether it is transformed.
Truant's loafing turn.
Its current types, one flag per type of the vocabulary (the engine's typeless marker ??? sets none).
Whether it used its item this turn.
Turns until each pending slot condition resolves, as the seat counts them.
The stall counter the seat derives from the shown stalling uses (0 none).
The derived suffix the seat was shown (stockpile2, perish3; a stat for Protosynthesis), as a number or a stat index.
Mask: the seat was shown each volatile (a line started it and none ended it).
The turn each volatile began as the seat saw it, -1 none.
Whether the seat's history facts are available (no tracker refused a line).
Turns since each field condition began, -1 none.
The seat's own request: 0 none, 1 preview, 2 move, 3 forced switch.
Turns since the terrain began, -1 none.
Turns since the weather began, -1 none (the reducer's elapsed.weather).
Mask: the seat knows the ability.
What the seat knows of whether it was brought: 0 unknown, 1 not brought, 2 brought.
Whether the seat can settle the Pokemon's own facts: 0 no entry, 1 unknown, 2 known.
Whether the seat can settle the facts of the Pokemon's position: 0 not in play, 1 unknown, 2 known.

The hit points the seat was last shown, -1 never: exact for its own Pokemon, the display percentage for another's. A benched Pokemon's value is the last display (a silent change, such as a switch-out heal, is not shown).
Mask: the seat knows the held item (an own Pokemon: its request; another: a line showed it).
Mask: the seat knows the move in each slot.
Mask: the seat was shown the nickname.
An extra entry the seat's channel forced (Illusion).
Damage dealt last turn in the target's units as the seat sees them.
Damage dealt this turn in the target's units as the seat sees them.
Damage taken last turn in the units the seat sees.
Damage taken this turn in the units the seat sees.
Its place among that turn's actions.
The turn of its latest action, -1 none.
The last move the seat saw it choose.
The turn of that move, -1 none.
Its last target as shown: 0 none, else 1 + side * 3 + slot letter.
Consecutive turns of successful stalling uses.
The species forme the seat was shown at this roster entry (a disguise until it breaks).
Mask: the seat was shown the Pokemon's real species forme (not a disguise).
A temporary forme the seat was shown.
The types a typechange line showed, one flag per type.
Turns since each side condition began, -1 none.
Turns left of a timed side condition; it can depend on the source's item, so no seat is shown it (the seat's elapsed turns are its view).
The layers of a stacking side condition (0 for one that does not stack).
Whether each side condition is up.
The Pokemon that fainted last turn: 0 none, else 1 + its roster index.
The Pokemon that fainted this turn: 0 none, else 1 + its roster index.
Pokemon of the side not fainted.
Pokemon the side brought (after Team Preview) or showed (at it).
Pokemon of the side that have fainted.

out_of_scope.reason: Probe rows per candidate (probe-damage, probe-outcome): computed by the mechanics probe from assumed sets, not battle state.
The candidate's target token: an index of the candidate's own choice into the tokens, not battle state.
The belief's opponent sheet block: a function of the opponent model and the seat's view, not battle state.

world_items.reason: Terastallization, Z-Moves, Dynamax and Ultra Burst are not mechanics of the format: the spec holds none of their state, and their engine keys are omitted as not_in_format.
